qokeody.meaning: Vapour in the one written case.

dody.meaning: The same material becomes the specified state, not filling a container.

shedy.meaning: Disjunction of result alternatives with the same explicitly introduced subject and process.

new_grammar: Postfix transition: X Y dody = BECOMES(X,Y).
Explicit gapping: X Y dody shedy Z = BECOMES(X,Y) OR BECOMES(X,Z), with exactly shared X/dody; no fresh subject or operation.
design.two_input_consequence: The same vapour/process combines with two distinct state values. A preceding/following written guard must distinguish the outcomes; the line alone is nondeterministic.
design.serious_rival: The predicate is naming/classification, not material transformation; no physical continuity or event order follows.
design.falsifier: Fail if qodaiin elsewhere must name an age or organ instead of dew, if shedy needs an ordinary assertion rather than the same-subject alternative, or if a complete reading makes frost and dew the same state.
design.hard_countercase: IT has csedy at the coordinator position; RF and other contexts have marked alternatives. Other shedy occurrences in S/W need the same strict gapping contract. No generic global conjunction is inferred.
design.freedom: 5 whole-form values,2 productions,1 explicit ellipsis construction; guards and case binding still unassigned. Similar spellings qokeody/qoekedy are distinct, not exchangeable.
